item.title: Sei Famiresu Gakuen
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Black Light
  • 発売日: 2003-03-28
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 聖ファミレス学園
  • 英語名: Sei Famiresu Gakuen

あらすじ

Vocational schools are opened in a little distance from Tokyo in an attempt to revive family restaurant industry. The world’s first family restaurant salesperson training school opens its doors! Main character is the store manager who is responsible for apprenticeship and evaluation of waitress girls. This year there is a contest to choose “Miss family”. A fun and challenging weeks starts.

item.title: Gakkou no Kyaa! ~Sennichi Gakuen Shinbunbu no Teinou Kaiki Eigateki Sekai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Black Light
  • 発売日: 2000-09-29
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 学校のきゃあ！～千日学園新聞部の低能怪奇映画的世界～
  • 英語名: Gakkou no Kyaa! Sennichi Gakuen Shinbunbu no Teinou Kaiki Eigateki Sekai

あらすじ

School yellow pages newspaper covers psychic phenomena and strange cases inside and outside the school. It has a colorful cast. Main character is sent as a spy to this school club. Is it possible for a normal person to compete against monsters and conspiracies that await him in the evenings?
